summary: Nomura Holdings filed a Form 6-K with a supplement for financial highlights for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The filing reports net revenue of 686.7 billion yen, net income attributable to shareholders of 145.6 billion yen, and EPS of 49.90 yen basic. It includes balance sheet and capital ratios, with no mention of any merger, acquisition, tender offer, or other special-situation transaction. This is a routine earnings-related report by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. No deal terms, advisors, or board actions are present.
